title: Saturday
summary: A day name with a Roman clue waiting further down the trail.
question: Where did Saturday get its name?
completion: Saturday keeps Saturn’s name from a Roman day-name tradition. English adapted the name and used its own word for day. French samedi follows a Sabbath-day name instead.
partner: A similar sound is a clue. Let’s check the evidence.
